location: data.p12.owner_projection on authorized P12 stock detail GETs

sources.supplier: mini_app_inbound_record_metadata.document_id after fresh canonical receipt ID/type/warehouse/deleted_at/ACL checks
sources.creator: stock_documents.created_by; optional current label from that actor's app_user row, never the caller

supplier.snapshot: supplier_id, supplier_name, supplier_version, recorded_at persisted by P04 RECORD
supplier.name_status: SNAPSHOT_RECORDED, NOT_RECORDED, NOT_SELECTED, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or NOT_APPLICABLE; never use current directory to fill null
supplier.recorded_at: RFC3339 UTC Z via document-timestamps-v1. Preserve only database precision; PostgreSQL timestamptz(0) produces zero fractional digits padded to six, not invented microseconds.

creator.display_name: null with HISTORICAL_SNAPSHOT_NOT_RECORDED; no historical display name exists
creator.current_display_name: separate current directory label, never substituted for historical display_name
creator.current_display_name_source: app_user.display_name; FE must explicitly identify this as the current directory name, not a historical snapshot
creator.current_display_name_permission: iam.user.view; otherwise null with REDACTED_PII_PERMISSION, without reading the user directory
creator.current_display_name_scope: Existing ACTIVE, non-deleted actor directory entry only. NOT_RECORDED does not imply missing historical identity.
creator.role: null with HISTORICAL_SNAPSHOT_NOT_RECORDED; no historical role exists

scope: Owner middleware remains authoritative; exact document ID and persisted warehouse are rechecked by projection queries.

errors.403: Missing inbound.view/outbound.view or warehouse scope; no projection
errors.404: Unknown, deleted, wrong-type or missing-warehouse parent; explicit selected warehouse or stale cached identity mismatch
errors.422: Malformed explicit warehouse_id; no guessed scope
errors.optional_source_failure: Retain successful authorized parent/lines/files contract; mark only affected optional projection SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE with null values. Do not turn it into NOT_RECORDED or empty parent.
errors.parent_source_failure: Propagates normal owner/server error; never an empty document

cache: Owner response cache remains, but owner_projection is freshly resolved after authorization and is never inserted into shared parent payload cache. Recheck live parent even on a cache hit.

user_decision.decision: Use the current creator directory name and explicitly identify its source.
user_decision.missing_or_redacted: Keep null and the returned status; do not substitute caller, historical display_name, role or another directory entry.
user_decision.scope: Display-source choice only; no new IAM grant, historical snapshot, deployment approval or UAT PASS.

approval: User confirmed the current-name display choice on 2026-10-19. Remaining owner/IAM/privacy review and live TC_UAT_12 acceptance are pending; historical creator name/role remain unavailable without persisted source.
privacy: No raw audit JSON, password, token, phone or customer PII is projected.
